messages:
maya: Quick sync — can we lock a 60m slot next week to go over the privacy intake for Payments V2 and the RBAC changes? I put a short intake form + rough notes here: https://redwood.internal/docs/payments-v2-intake :link: 

owen: +1. Can we target early next week? I prefer Tue/Wed mornings. Also need to loop in platform for the migration notes.

julie: Tue morning works for me. What should we prep — threat model only or full compliance checklist?

maya: Main goal: review intake responses, validate threat-model assumptions, and sign off on access scoping for the new svc accounts. If we finish early we can triage leftover TODOs.

priya: Heads up from compliance: please add the PCI scoping doc as pre-read. I added comments to the intake form. Pre-reads due by EOD Monday so we can be efficient.

maya: OK pulling those in. Proposed time slots (please react with ✅ for availability):
- Tue 2026-02-03 09:00-10:00 PT
- Tue 2026-02-03 11:00-12:00 PT
- Wed 2026-02-04 08:30-09:30 PT
- Wed 2026-02-04 10:00-11:00 PT

owen: ✅ for Tue 09. Not available for Wed AM.

julie: ✅ Tue 11 also ok if we need more time.

priya: Prefer Wed 10 to avoid overlap with compliance ops review. If others prefer Tue 09 though, I can rearrange.

maya: Noted. If no consensus by EOD today I'll book Tue 09 since infra team is usually online then.

infra-bot: calendar: Event created draft "Payments V2 — privacy intake & RBAC review" (organizer: maya). Invitees: maya, owen, julie, priya, infra.ics attached. Use /confirm to finalize.

julie: Agenda suggestion: 1) intake quick walkthrough (10m) 2) threat-model (25m) 3) RBAC scoping + migration notes (15m) 4) next steps & owners (10m). Can we add a short demo of the current access logs?

maya: Good agenda — adding demo. Also small checklist for pre-read + doc links:
```
- fill intake form (link above)
- read PCI scoping doc (priya comments)
- tag any obvious sensitive flows in the threat-model doc
- attach sample access logs if you want demoed
```

owen: Will upload sample logs by Monday.

priya: I'll mark the compliance checklist as reviewed by EOD.

maya: Thanks — last ask: if you have a blocking risk (data exfil / third-party access), call it out in the intake form under "high priority" so we can start mitigation planning.

julie: ack.

maya: tagging @owen @julie @priya — please react to one option by 5pm PT. I'll finalize the invite after that. :calendar:
